verdict.rationale: Brex's own Expenses API has a 'Receipt Match' endpoint: a receipt is uploaded to a pre-signed URL and Brex 'will try to match the receipt with existing expenses' (brex-docs-7, brex-docs-27, brex-docs-54). Brex also says its AI assistants handle employee expenses, including 'fetching receipts' (brex-docs-23). This covers the auto-matching core, but only through an API, and nothing shows the employee-facing capture paths or explicit OCR. Missing for 10: mobile photo capture of receipts, an email-forwarding receipt inbox, explicit OCR/data extraction from receipts, evidence of matching accuracy, independent or hands-on corroboration.
